pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
Freezes hostile mobs with a fear aura, and can take a fatal hit for the owner.

HP: 120. Regen IV + Resistance II.

pages.title: Fear Aura
pages.text:
Radius: 16 blocks.
• Hostile mobs lose targeting — cannot attack, pathfind, or jump
• Mobs take +50% extra damage (x1.5 vulnerability)
• Physics still apply (gravity, knockback)

pages.title: Sacrifice Mechanic
pages.text:
When the owner takes fatal damage:
• Priority 1: deployed Pale Doll within 16 blocks → killed
• Priority 2: named Pale Doll Egg in inventory → becomes invalid
• Effect: Totem sound + visual + 100 temp HP (60s)

Does not trigger on /kill or void damage.

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text: Craft the Pale Doll Head, then the Pale Doll Egg. Name the egg on an anvil to summon.

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text: 8 pale oak logs surround the head.
